newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli provident funds post outflow in March.
newsitem.headline: Israeli provident funds post outflow in March.

text.p: Net redemptions in Israeli provident funds reached 210 million shekels in March bringing total withdrawals for the year to 699 million shekels, Israel's Finance Ministry said on Tuesday.
In the same period in 1996 the funds posted net redemptions of 457 million shekels. The provident funds suffered net withdrawals of 12 billion shekels in all of 1996.
Provident funds are long-term savings schemes that invest most in Treasury bonds and the stock market.
The ministry also said bank deposits suffered net withdrawals for March of 343 million shekels, bringing the year's withdrawals in that sector to 917 million shekels.
It said inflation-linked deposits lost 305 million shekels in March while those linked to foreign currency lost 38 million.

Savings accounts had been recipients of deposits in the last two years, taking in a total of 5.36 billion shekels last year alone. Banking sources have attributed the savings withdrawals to falling interest rates.
